name: flx
description: Language support for .flx — syntax highlighting, diagnostics, completion, hover and go-to-definition

flx.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to a compiled `flx_lsp` executable. Leave empty to run the server from source with `dart run`, which is slower to start but always matches the checkout.

flx.server.packagePath.markdownDescription: Location of the `flx_lsp` package, relative to the workspace root. Only used when `#flx.server.path#` is empty.

flx.semanticDiagnostics.markdownDescription:
Report Dart type errors against the `.flx` that produced them.

On save this transpiles the folder and runs `dart analyze`, so generated `.dart` files are written as a side effect. Turn it off to keep the editor read-only; syntax diagnostics are unaffected.

flx.trace.server.description: Log LSP traffic to the flx output channel.
